name: atelier
description: Atelier — the operating model for working with Claude as a teammate, distributed as an installable plugin. This repo is both the plugin and its own marketplace.

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Apex honesty doctrine; six subjects holding sixteen actions, each run as /atelier:<subject> <action> (review: brief, plan and run; work: run and plan; fleet: sweep and pins; worktree: start, list, land and remove; repo: scan, hook and create; session: onramp and close), and a bare subject shows its menu. A named worked example — adopt it by becoming the principal.
